## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · seat `domain:ui#1` · 2026-10-26T08:39Z

Head `32c20dedd8e0` (read from the PR object).

- **Shape.** Draft on `main`; `Fixes #25899`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; changeset `.changeset/25899-monaco-self-host.md` in the root `.changeset/` (patch, plugin-editor / app-shell / console).
- **Checks pinned to the head.** 62 named check runs, latest per name: 57 success, 5 skipped, 0 failing, 0 pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI all success.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25993`: 0 of 28 paths governed, +524/-89.
- **New runtime dependency.** `monaco-editor@^0.55.1` in `@object-ui/plugin-editor` (lockfile +3, through `pnpm install`). The maintainer already made this call on 2026-10-25 (option A, self-host), as triage records on the card (comment 6409510137). The version is the one `@monaco-editor/loader` 1.7.0 was fetching from the CDN, so the editor itself does not change.
- **Surface.** Within the claim, plus the three studio-design test stubs on the claim amendment and the other metadata-admin test files that mock the same probe (a one-line stub each, named in the PR body).
- **Changeset against the diff.** `configureBundledMonaco(loader)` imports the ESM core lazily and calls `loader.config({ monaco })` before the first `init()`; workers come from `?worker` on first request; a failed import resets and the callers fall back to a textarea; `useMonacoFallback` awaits the config before probing. Each sentence matches the code. The cost is +13.5 MB of lazy JS under `assets/`, and the first-paint closure is unchanged (+103 B, measured by the dev).
- **Out-of-scope notes.** The stale jsdelivr comment in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` and the `ui/apps/site` playground still on the CDN go to Acceptance notes. Neither is a defect a user meets in the Console.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the relay.
